https://documentation.wazuh.com/current/.claim: The current enrollment troubleshooting page distinguishes 1514/TCP agent communication, 1515/TCP enrollment via agent configuration, and 55000/TCP enrollment via the API. The required enrollment port depends on the method used.

https://docs.docker.com/engine/network/p.claim: Docker documents that published container traffic is diverted before the INPUT and OUTPUT chains used by UFW, so UFW alone does not govern those published ports.

https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/reference.claim: Traefik's Swarm provider reads labels on services. In a Compose definition for Swarm these routing labels belong under deploy.labels.
